title: Proof of depth 2 identification bloch suslin
html:
Proof. Proof of depth 2 identification bloch suslin

Proof chain

Step 1 (Bloch group, Bloch 1978). Define the Bloch group of F:

  \mathfrak{B}(F)
  \;:=\;
  \mathbb{Z}[F^\times \setminus \{1\}] \;/\; \bigl(\text{5-term relations, torsion}\bigr)

where the 5-term relations are

  \{x\}_2 - \{y\}_2 + \left\{\tfrac{y}{x}\right\}_2 - \left\{\tfrac{1 - x^{-1}}{1 - y^{-1}}\right\}_2 + \left\{\tfrac{1 - x}{1 - y}\right\}_2 \;=\; 0

for all x, y \in F^\times with x, y, x/y \neq 1.

The Bloch–Wigner dilogarithm D \colon F \to \mathbb{R} extends \mathbb{Q}-linearly to a well-defined map

  D \;\colon\; \mathfrak{B}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q} \;\longrightarrow\; \mathbb{R} \big/ \pi^2 \mathbb{Q}

because D satisfies the 5-term relation as a function on F-points (Wigner 1955; Bloch 1978).

Step 2 (Suslin's isomorphism, Suslin 1986). Theorem (Suslin). There is a natural isomorphism of \mathbb{Q}-vector spaces

  K_3^{\mathrm{ind}}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q}
  \;\cong\;
  \mathfrak{B}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q}

induced by sending the generator \{x\}_2 \in \mathfrak{B}(F) to the corresponding class in K_3^{\mathrm{ind}} via the Bloch–Wigner / Beilinson regulator. The composed map

  K_3^{\mathrm{ind}}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q}
  \;\xrightarrow{\;\sim\;}\;
  \mathfrak{B}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q}
  \;\xrightarrow{\;D\;}\;
  \mathbb{R} \big/ \pi^2 \mathbb{Q}

is the Bloch–Suslin regulator, and it is injective after tensoring with \mathbb{R} (Borel + Suslin).

Step 3 (archimedean image of G^{(2)}, this paper). The substrate convolution algebra \mathcal{H}_q's depth-2 grouplike \mathrm{Li}_2^q(z) for z \in F^\times has archimedean image

  \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}\!\bigl(\mathrm{Li}_2^q(z)\bigr)
  \;=\;
  \mathrm{Li}_2(z) \pmod{\mathcal{P}_1}

by prop:categorical-laplace-unique combined with the analytic continuation of \mathrm{Li}_2^q to \mathrm{Li}_2 at q \to 1. The Bloch–Wigner companion

  D(z)
  \;=\;
  \mathrm{Im}\,\mathrm{Li}_2(z) + \arg(1-z)\log|z|

is the single-valued version of \mathrm{Li}_2, well-defined modulo \pi^2 \mathbb{Q}. Comparing:

  \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}\!\bigl(\mathrm{Li}_2^q(z)\bigr) \pmod{\mathcal{P}_1}
  \;\sim\;
  D(z) \pmod{\pi^2 \mathbb{Q}}.

Step 4 (composition). Combining Steps 1–3:

  \begin{array}{rcl}
    G^{(2)}(\mathcal{H}_q)\big|_F \big/ \mathcal{P}_1
    & \xrightarrow{\;\;\tau_{\mathrm{arch}}\;\;} &
    \mathbb{R} / \pi^2 \mathbb{Q} \\
    \downarrow \text{(generated by $\mathrm{Li}_2^q(z),\ z \in F^\times$)} & & \uparrow D \\
    \mathfrak{B}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q}
    & \xrightarrow[\;\;\sim\;\;]{\text{Suslin}} &
    K_3^{\mathrm{ind}}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q}
  \end{array}

The diagonal arrow G^{(2)}\big|_F \big/ \mathcal{P}_1 \to K_3^{\mathrm{ind}}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q} is bijective after tensoring with \mathbb{R} by the combination of Suslin's isomorphism and Borel's regulator injectivity. \square

Scope of the result

Proved:

  • G^{(2)}(\mathcal{H}_q)\big|_F \big/ \mathcal{P}_1 has dimension \dim K_3^{\mathrm{ind}}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q} = r_2 (Borel for n = 2), where r_2 = number of complex places of F.
  • Image of \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} on G^{(2)}|_F equals image of Bloch–Suslin regulator on K_3^{\mathrm{ind}}(F).
  • For each Bring-natural F = \mathbb{Q}(z_K), the depth-2 row of rem:transcendental-accounting is a theorem, not a conjecture.

Not proved by this:

  • Identification of abstract Hopf algebras: G^{(2)}(\mathcal{H}_q) as a Hopf algebra over F vs K_3^{\mathrm{ind}}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q} as a \mathbb{Q}-vector space. The image-direction match is what is proved here; abstract structural equivalence requires the motivic interpretation of \mathcal{H}_q (open).
  • Generation of all of \mathcal{P}_2 / \mathcal{P}_1 across all number fields by G^{(2)}(\mathcal{H}_q). This is depth-2 generation, expected but technical (compatibility across F's).

Generalisations (depth \geq 3, conditional)

The same proof chain at depth 3 requires:

Step Depth-2 ingredient Depth-3 analog Status
1 (Bloch group) \mathfrak{B}(F) via 5-term relations Goncharov's \mathfrak{B}_3(F) via 22-term relations conjecturally complete
2 (Suslin isom.) K_3^{\mathrm{ind}}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q} \cong \mathfrak{B}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q} K_5^{\mathrm{ind}}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q} \cong \mathfrak{B}_3(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q} Goncharov's motivic conjecture (open)
3 (single-valued) Bloch–Wigner D(z) Goncharov D_3(z) — single-valued trilog provable
4 (image direction) \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} \mathrm{Li}_2^q = D \pmod{\mathcal{P}_1} \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} \mathrm{Li}_3^q = D_3 \pmod{\mathcal{P}_2} provable

Steps 3, 4 generalize. Step 2 (Goncharov's motivic conjecture) is the open piece. Conditional on Step 2, the depth-3 identification follows by the same argument.
